rows.grounds: compound pāṇi+pīḍā; accusative object; ca conjunction
dative of the person for whom the action is done; api adds even

items.question: Should dispute and hand-pain be caused even for a long-lived woman?
premises: Even a long-lived woman is included.
items.inference: The verse prescribes causing both dispute and hand-pain even in the case of a long-lived woman.
uncertainties: The ritual or social context of causing dispute and hand-pain is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Indeed, even for a long-lived woman, one should cause dispute and hand-pain.
